title: Stable retained delegation cleanup polls advance the child mutation stamp
outcome: Unchanged terminal status/result polls of a retained dedicated cleanup failure leave the child mutation_stamp stable; mutating/claiming paths still stamp their actual changes.
acceptance: An unchanged retained-failure or busy-cleanup poll uses immutable inspection before stamped mutable access; actual cleanup claims or visible state changes still advance the correct child's stamp.
A deterministic regression asserts stable child mutation_stamp and revision across repeated unchanged terminal status/result reads, and preserves the exact failed-owner public Stop retry behavior.
